description: V0.17 curated naming batch 7 (46 entries). Manual semantic naming from capstone disasm of high-frequency sub_ functions (callers>=5). ARM9: global flag OR/ANDNOT set (IRQ-safe), struct init/switch, shared-mem indexed set, switch dispatch, tail-call thunks (literal-pool target extracted). ARM7: slot-table lookup, state fixup/switch, halfword bit RMW, array lookups.

names.name: global_flags_or_set_irq_safe
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#0x28]; ldrh r3,[ip]; mov r1,#0; strh r1,[ip]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x1c]; ldr r1,[r2]; orr r0,r1,r0; str r0,[r2]; ldrh r0,[ip]; strh r3,[ip]; mov r0,r1; bx lr
names.note: callers=15. IRQ-safe atomic OR into global word flag (hword save/restore around critical section). Returns previous word value.

names.name: global_flags_andnot_clear_irq_safe
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#0x2c]; ldrh r3,[ip]; mov r1,#0; strh r1,[ip]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x20]; ldr r1,[r2]; mvn r0,r0; and r0,r1,r0; str r0,[r2]; ldrh r0,[ip]; strh r3,[ip]; mov r0,r1; bx lr
names.note: callers=14. IRQ-safe atomic AND-NOT (clear bits) into global word flag. Twin of 0x021041fc.

names.name: global_0x300_field_range_sub
names.disasm: ldr r1,[pc,#0x18]; cmp r0,r1; ldrhs r1,[pc,#0x14]; ldrhs r1,[r1]; addhs r1,r1,#0x300; ldrhhs r1,[r1,#0xde]; subhs r0,r0,r1; bx lr
names.note: callers=13. If r0 >= const, subtract global[+0x300+0xde] halfword (range clamp/adjust).

names.name: struct_field_switch_add
names.note: callers=10. Switch r2 in {0,1,2} selects struct field offset 0x24/0x2c/0x28 then adds to r1.

names.name: struct_init_0x1c_fields
names.disasm: mov r3,#0; str r3,[r0]; ldr r2,[r0]; mov r1,#0xe; str r2,[r0,#4]; str r3,[r0,#0x1c]; ...; str r1,[r0,#0x10]
names.note: callers=10. Struct field init: zero 0x00/0x04/0x08/0x0c/0x18/0x1c, set 0x10=0xe, copy chains.

names.name: poll_loop_3_calls
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; mov r0,#0; bl 0x210f688; bl 0x2106940; bl 0x2100adc; b 0x2106ae4
names.note: callers=10. Poll loop: calls 3 funcs then branches back (infinite wait loop).

names.name: wrapper_call_2_funcs
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; bl 0x2026c5c; bl 0x2027364; add sp,sp,#4; ldm sp!,{lr}; bx lr
names.note: callers=9. Thin wrapper calling 2 sub-functions sequentially.

names.name: array_8slot_clear
names.disasm: mov r3,#0; ldr r1,[pc,#0x68]; mov r2,r3; str r2,[r1,r3,lsl#3]; add r0,r1,r3,lsl#3; str r2,[r0,#4]; add r3,r3,#1; cmp r3,#8; blt...
names.note: callers=9. Loop clearing 8 slots of a stride-8 word array.

names.name: global_ptr_field4_get
names.disasm: ldr r0,[pc,#4]; ldr r0,[r0,#4]; bx lr
names.note: callers=8. Read global pointer then load word at [ptr+4].

names.name: list_scan_50_for_nonzero
names.disasm: ldr r1,[pc,#0x28]; mov r0,#0; ldr r2,[r1]; mov r3,r0; ldr r1,[r2,#8]; add r3,r3,#1; cmp r1,#0; movne r0,r1; cmp r3,#0x32; add r2,r2,#0x1c; blt...
names.note: callers=8. Scan linked list (stride 0x1c, up to 50) returning first nonzero [8] field.

names.name: io_bitmask_byte_set
names.disasm: ands r1,r0,#1; ldrne r1,[pc,#0x88]; movne r2,#0x80; strbne r2,[r1]; ands r1,r0,#2; ...; ands r1,r0,#4; ...
names.note: callers=8. Bitmask arg -> write 0x80 byte to per-bit IO address (likely SPI/EEPROM chip selects).

names.name: shared_mem_da0_indexed_set
names.disasm: lsl r0,r0,#2; add r0,r0,#0x2700000; add r0,r0,#0xff000; str r1,[r0,#0xda0]; bx lr
names.note: callers=8. idx*4 + 0x27ff000 + 0xda0 -> store word (shared RAM indexed write).

names.name: halfword_flag_to_state
names.disasm: ldr r0,[pc,#0x10]; ldrh r0,[r0]; cmp r0,#0; movne r0,#0; moveq r0,#3; bx lr
names.note: callers=8. Global halfword !=0 -> 0, ==0 -> 3 (state code from flag).

names.name: switch_dispatch_5way
names.note: callers=7. Jump table dispatch on r0 in 0..4 (5 cases).

names.name: global_flags_or_set_irq_safe_b
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#0x28]; mov r1,#0; ldrh r3,[ip]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x20]; strh r1,[ip]; ldr r1,[r2]; orr r0,r1,r0; str r0,[r2]; ldrh r0,[ip]; mov r0,r1; strh r3,[ip]; bx lr
names.note: callers=7. Same IRQ-safe atomic OR as 0x021041fc (different global).

names.name: shared_mem_dc4_indexed_set
names.disasm: lsl r0,r0,#2; add r0,r0,#0x2700000; add r0,r0,#0xff000; str r1,[r0,#0xdc4]; bx lr
names.note: callers=7. Twin of 0x02039718 with +0xdc4 offset.

names.name: slot_array_0x84_field_0x14_set
names.disasm: ldr r2,[pc,#0x10]; ldr r2,[r2]; ldr r2,[r2,#0x84]; add r0,r2,r0,lsl#4; str r1,[r0,#0x14]; bx lr
names.note: callers=6. Global ptr->[0x84] array, idx*16 slot, write word at +0x14.

names.name: switch_dispatch_7way
names.note: callers=6. Jump table dispatch on r0 in 0..6 (7 cases).

names.name: switch_dispatch_7way_b
names.note: callers=6. Twin of 0x02039740 (different handlers).

names.name: mod4_loop
names.disasm: subs r0,r0,#4; bhs 0x2039f9c; bx lr
names.note: callers=6. Loop subtracting 4 until r0<4 (mod-4 remainder / 4-byte alignment delay).

names.name: struct_state_init_flags
names.disasm: ldr r3,[r0,#0xc]; mov r2,#0; orr r3,r3,#4; str r3,[r0,#0xc]; ldr r3,[r0,#8]; ldr ip,[pc,#0x14]; str r3,[r0,#0x30]; str r2,[r0,#0x38]; strh r2,[r0,#0x36]; strh r1,[r0,#0x34]; mov r1,#2; bx ip
names.note: callers=6. Struct state init: set flag bit 4 in [0xc], copy [8]->[0x30], write 0x34/0x36/0x38, tail-call.

names.name: global_ptr_field4_get_b
names.disasm: ldr r0,[pc,#8]; ldr r0,[r0]; ldr r0,[r0,#4]; bx lr
names.note: callers=6. Twin of 0x0200a06c (different global).

names.name: memcpy_word_loop
names.disasm: add ip,r1,r2; cmp r1,ip; ldmlt r0!,{r2}; stmlt r1!,{r2}; blt...; bx lr
names.note: callers=6. Word-chunk memcpy loop (r0=src r1=dst r2=count).

names.name: multiply_guard_0x18_formula
names.disasm: cmp r1,#0x18; bge 0x2107458; ldr r2,[pc,#0x54]; ldr r3,[r2]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x50]; sub r2,r2,r3; add r1,r1,#0x28; mul r1,r3,r1; add r1,r1,r2,lsl#6; mul r1,r0,r1; asr r0,r1,#0x15; bx lr
names.note: callers=6. Guarded multiply formula (r1<0x18) using two globals; result asr 21.

names.name: tail_call_02027a40
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#4]; ldr r1,[pc,#4]; bx ip
names.note: callers=8. Tail call thunk -> 0x02027a40 (literal-pool target).

names.name: tail_call_02037f08
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc]; bx ip
names.note: callers=8. Tail call thunk -> 0x02037f08.

names.name: tail_call_02035470
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#4]; ldr r0,[pc,#4]; bx ip
names.note: callers=6. Tail call thunk -> 0x02035470.

names.name: call_indirect_const_to_020367ec
names.disasm: ldr ip,[pc,#0xc]; ldr r0,[pc,#0xc]; mov r1,#0; mov r2,#0xc000; bx ip
names.note: callers=8. Indirect call 0x020367ec with const args r1=0 r2=0xc000.

names.name: global_compute_write
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#0xc; bl 0x2106940; ldr r1,[pc,#0x8c]; ldrh r1,[r1]; strh r1,[sp]; ldr r1,[pc,#0x84]; ldr ip,[r1]; ldr r3,[r1,#4]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x7c]; mvn r1,#0; and r2,r3,r2
names.note: callers=6. Reads globals, computes AND of [ptr+4] with masked const, writes back.

names.name: arm7_slot_table_24b_lookup
names.disasm: push {r0,r1,r2,r3}; push {r4,r5,r6,lr}; mov r5,r0; mov r4,r1; ldrh r0,[sp,#0x18]; cmp r0,#4; movhi r0,#0; bhi...; bl 0x237e140; ldr r2,[pc,#0x98]; ldr r3,[r2,#0x48c]; mov r1,#0x18; mul ip,r3,r1
names.note: callers=15. ARM7: validate index<4 else 0; lookup 24-byte slot table at global[+0x48c].

names.name: arm7_indirect_dispatch
names.disasm: add r2,r2,#1; lsr r2,r2,#1; ldr ip,[pc]; bx ip
names.note: callers=9. ARM7: (r2+1)>>1 then indirect dispatch via literal pool.

names.name: arm7_wrapper_call
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; mov ip,r0; mov r3,r1; str r2,[sp]; ldr r0,[pc,#0x14]; mov r1,ip; ldr r2,[pc,#0x10]; bl 0x33a6138; ...
names.note: callers=8. ARM7 thin wrapper forwarding args to 0x33a6138 (lib entry).

names.name: arm7_store_pair_le_0xf
names.disasm: cmp r0,#0xf; ldrle r1,[pc,#0x10]; strle r0,[r1]; movle r1,#0; ldrle r0,[pc,#8]; strle r1,[r0]; bx lr
names.note: callers=7. ARM7: if r0<=15 store r0 to global A and 0 to global B.

names.name: arm7_struct_field_2_get
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; bl 0x2394194; ldrh r0,[r0,#2]; add sp,sp,#4; ldm sp!,{lr}; bx lr
names.note: callers=7. ARM7: call 0x2394194 then read halfword [ret+2].

names.name: arm7_state_fixup
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; mov r0,#0; mov r1,#0x32; bl 0x2383768; ldr r0,[pc,#0x24]; ldr r1,[r0]; ldr r0,[r1]; cmp r0,#4; moveq r0,#6; streq r0,[r1]
names.note: callers=6. ARM7: init then fixup state ==4 -> 6.

names.name: arm7_header_magic_check
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r3,[r0,#8]; sub lr,r3,#4; ldrh r2,[r3,#-4]; ldr r1,[pc,#0x6c]; cmp r2,r1; bne...; ldrh r2,[lr,#2]; ldr r1,[pc,#0x60]; cmp r2,r1; beq...
names.note: callers=6. ARM7: validate two halfword magic values in data header.

names.name: arm7_state_switch_1_2_3
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r2,[pc,#0x94]; ldr r2,[r2]; ldr r2,[r2,#0x24]; cmp r2,#1; beq...; cmp r2,#2; beq...; cmp r2,#3; beq...
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: switch on global->[0x24] state 1/2/3.

names.name: arm7_flag_bit_test
names.disasm: mov r2,#1; ldr r1,[pc,#0x10]; ldr r1,[r1]; add r1,r1,#0x300; ldrh r1,[r1,#0x2c]; and r0,r1,r2,lsl r0; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: test bit r0 of global[+0x300+0x2c] halfword.

names.name: arm7_acc_field_0x50
names.disasm: ldr r0,[pc,#0x1f0]; ldr r1,[r0]; ldr r0,[pc,#0x1ec]; add r1,r1,r0; ldr r0,[pc,#0x1e8]; ldrh r2,[r0]; ldr r3,[r1,#0x50]; and r2,r2,#0xff; add r2,r3,r2; str r2,[r1,#0x50]
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: accumulate byte (AND 0xff) into global[+0x50] word.

names.name: arm7_halfword_shift_set
names.disasm: lsr r2,r0,#1; ldr r1,[pc,#0x18]; ldr r1,[r1]; add r1,r1,#0x300; strh r2,[r1,#0x54]; ldr r1,[pc,#0xc]; strh r0,[r1]; mov r0,#0; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: r0>>1 -> global[+0x354], r0 -> global B, return 0.

names.name: arm7_range_check_write
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; cmp r0,#0xa; blo...; cmp r0,#0x3e8; bls...; mov r0,#5; b...; ldr r2,[pc,#0x30]; ldr r1,[r2]; add r1,r1,#0x300; strh r0,[r1,#0xb2]
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: validate r0 in [0xa,0x3e8] else 5; store to global[+0x3b2].

names.name: arm7_slot_0x31c_copy
names.disasm: mov r1,#0x1c; ldr r2,[pc,#0x14]; ldr r2,[r2]; ldr r2,[r2,#0x31c]; mla r1,r0,r1,r2; ldrh r0,[r1,#0x1a]; strh r0,[r1,#0x18]; bx lr
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: global->[0x31c] slot array (stride 0x1c), copy halfword [0x1a]->[0x18].

names.name: arm7_bits_rmw
names.disasm: ldr r2,[pc,#0x4c]; ldr r3,[r2]; ldr r2,[pc,#0x48]; add ip,r3,r2; ldrh r3,[ip,#2]; mov r2,#1; mvn r2,r2,lsl r0; and r2,r3,r2; orr r0,r2,r1,lsl r0; strh r0,[ip,#2]
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: read-modify-write bit field r0 (val r1) at global+2 halfword.

names.name: arm7_node_init_copy
names.disasm: ldrh r2,[r1,#0xe]; add r2,r1,r2,lsl#1; add r3,r2,#0x10; ldrh r2,[r2,#0x10]; strh r2,[r1,#0xc]; mov r2,#2; strh r2,[r3,#2]; mov r2,#0; strh r2,[r3,#4]; ldrh r2,[r1,#0x18]; strh r2,[r3,#6]
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: linked-list node init/copy (halfword fields 0xc/0xe/0x10..).

names.name: arm7_array_0x14_lookup
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; ldr r1,[pc,#0x60]; ldr r2,[r1]; ldr r1,[pc,#0x5c]; add r2,r2,r1; mov r1,#0x14; mul r1,r0,r1; add r3,r2,r1; ldrh r0,[r2,r1]; cmp r0,#0; beq...
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: stride-0x14 array lookup by idx; checks first halfword nonzero.

names.name: arm7_flags_bit_decode
names.disasm: stmdb sp!,{lr}; sub sp,sp,#4; add r0,sp,#0; bl 0x239e68c; ldrh r1,[sp]; ands r0,r1,#1; movne r0,#0; bne...; ands r0,r1,#2; movne r0,#1; moveq r0,#0
names.note: callers=5. ARM7: read halfword, decode bit0->0 / bit1->1 / else 0.
